Crime & Law · India

Minors Held in Separate Murder Cases Across India

In Alappuzha, Kerala, a 13-year-old girl and three other minors were apprehended in connection with the murder of a man, with one report stating the girl allegedly gave the "quotation" for the killing. Separately, in Delhi's Burari area, a 16-year-old girl's body was found stuffed in a suitcase. Police arrested a cousin of the victim in this case. Another report from Hisar details the arrest of a father and grandfather in connection with the murder of a 14-year-old girl.
